---
css: 
    - "/assets/css/rg-table.css" 
title: "Search all Reporting Guidelines"

page-layout: full
listing:
    contents:
        - "*/index.qmd"
        - "!under-development/*/index.qmd"
        - "!under-development/index.qmd"
    type: table
    table-striped: true
    filter-ui: [keyword, title, acronym, clinical-specialty, categories, report-section]
    sort:
        - "search-priority asc"
        - "sticky desc"
        - title
    fields: 
        - acronym
        - title
        - categories
        - clinical-specialty

        # NB. only the first 5 columns will be shown. To add more visible columns,
        # change "n+6" in assets/css/rg-table.css 
        - keyword
        - search-priority
        - sticky
    field-display-names: 
      title: "Title"
      acronym: "Acronym"
      categories: "Study type"
      clinical-specialty: "Clinical area"
      report-section: "Section of report"
    categories: true
---
